name: Pinot Noir BARRIQUE organica – nefiltrirano
short_description:
Sofisticiran, nežan i istovremeno snažan, predstavlja savršenu ravnotežu između tradicije i
modernog pristupa stvaranju vina. Ovo novo, nefiltrirano izdanje izražava iskrenu filozofiju
vinarije: pustiti vinu da govori samo za sebe, bez suvišnih intervencija.
description:
PETRA Pinot Noir Barrique Organica – Nefiltriran na prvi pogled, vino osvaja svojom rubin-crvenom bojom s nežnim prozirnim nijansama terakote koje su karakteristične za sortu. Na mirisu se otkrivaju note zrelog crvenog i šumskog voća, uz suptilne tonove začina, koji dolaze iz pažljivog odležavanja.

Na nepcu je Pinot Noir svilenkast i uravnotežen, s finim taninima i elegantnom strukturom.

Svaka kap otkriva dubinu, slojevitost i toplinu koja ostaje dugo nakon gutljaja. Budući da je vino nefiltrirano, u njemu su sačuvane sve prirodne arome i tekstura, dajući mu pun karakter i iskrenu izražajnost.

Vino je u potpunosti pogodno za vegane, jer u procesu proizvodnje nisu korišćeni proizvodi životinjskog porekla, što dodatno potvrđuje posvećenost vinarije Petra prirodnom i održivom pristupu.

Vinifikacija

Sertifikacija: 100% organsko vino, vegan friendly
Sorta grožđa: 100% Pinot Noir
Oblast: Subotički rejon/ Palićko vinogorje/ Srbija/ Evropa
Vreme berbe: septembar
Period fermentacije: 10 dana
Količina alkohola: 14,5%
Zapremina: 0,75 l
Rok upotrebe: neograničeno
Godina berbe: 2024.

Starenje i odležavanje: Čuva se u hrastovim buradima od 500l, 8 do 10 meseci, srednje tostiranim iznutra kako bi odležavanjem vino upilo dodatno aromu drveta. Potom se najmanje još godinu dana ostavlja da odleži u boci, i tada dobijamo željenu sortnost vina Pinot Noir.

GASTRONOMSKE PREPORUKE / UPARIVANJE SA HRANOM

PETRA Pinot Noir je idealan izbor uz jela od crvenog, pačijeg mesa, gljiva ili zrelih sireva, ali i kao vino za opuštene trenutke u kojima želite da osjetite suštinu elegancije u čaši.

Otkrijte nefiltrirano Pinot Noir organica – vino koje spaja prefinjenost, prirodnost i karakter, u svakom gutljaju otkrivajući priču o zemlji, sorti i strasti prema stvaranju savršenog vina.

name: Traminac organica – nefiltrirano
short_description: Predstavljamo vam novo vino u ponudi vinarije PETRA – Traminac, sortu poznatu po svojoj eleganciji, aromatičnosti i izražajnom karakteru. Ova etiketa nastala je iz želje da se prikaže autentična lepota sorte kroz minimalne intervencije u podrumu, uz poštovanje prirodnog toka vina.
description:
Na prvi pogled, Traminac organica nefiltrirano vino osvaja svojom zlatnožutom bojom i blagom zamućenošću, koja je rezultat činjenice da vino nije filtrirano. Takav pristup čuva punoću ukusa i kompleksnost aroma, omogućavajući svakoj čaši da priča priču o zemlji, sorti i radu vinara.

Na mirisu, vino otkriva raskošne note ružinih latica, zrelih kajsija, meda i laganih začinskih tonova koji se skladno prepliću. Na nepcu je puno, zaokruženo i harmonično, s dugim i elegantnim završetkom koji ostavlja dojam topline i prefinjenosti.

Posebnost ovog vina leži i u njegovoj veganskoj prirodi – u procesu proizvodnje nisu korišćeni proizvodi životinjskog porekla, što ga čini idealnim izborom za sve koji traže čisto, iskreno vino nastalo s poštovanjem prema prirodi.

Vinifikacija

Sertifikacija: 100% organsko vino, vegan friendly
Sorta grožđa: 100% Traminac
Teroar: Subotički rejon/ Palićko vinogorje/ Srbija/ Evropa
Vreme berbe: septembar
Period fermentacije: 15 dana
Količina alkohola: 13%
Pakovanje: 0,75 l
Rok upotrebe: neograničeno
Godina berbe: 2024.

Starenje i odležavanje: Čuva se 10 meseci u inoks tanku, zatim sazreva još 12 meseci u boci.

GASTRONOMSKE PREPORUKE / UPARIVANJE SA HRANOM

Traminac vinarije PETRA savršeno će se slagati s aromatičnim jelima, laganim sirevima i jelima sa kremastim sosevima, ali može biti idealan pratilac za samostalno uživanje uz dobru knjigu ili razgovor.

Otkrijte PETRA Traminac organica nefiltrirano – vino koje spaja tradiciju, strast i savremeni pristup vinogradarstvu, nudeći iskustvo koje se pamti.

name: Pinot Grigio organica – nefiltrirano
short_description:
U svetu vina, malo koja sorta donosi toliko svežine, lakoće i elegancije kao Pinot Grigio.
Vinarija PETRA s ponosom predstavlja svoje novo izdanje ove plemenite sorte – vino koje spaja
čistoću izraza, prirodnu aromatiku i modernu interpretaciju tradicionalnog vinarskog pristupa.
description:
Na prvi pogled, Pinot Grigio organica nefiltrirano vino oduševljava svojom svetložutom bojom sa zelenkasto-sivkastim odsjajem, dok na mirisu otkriva prepoznatljive note citrusa, zelene jabuke, belog cveća i svežih krušaka. Na nepcu je izuzetno pitko, osvežavajuće i harmonično, s nežnom mineralnošću i uravnoteženom kiselinom koja mu daje živahnost i dužinu ukusa..

Pinot Grigio je nefiltriran, čime zadržava svoju autentičnost, punoću i prirodnu teksturu. Takav pristup omogućava da se u svakoj čaši oseti duh vinograda, tlo na kojem je grožđe raslo i pažnja kojom je vino stvarano.

Još jedna važna karakteristika ovog vina je njegova veganska podobnost – u procesu proizvodnje nisu korišćeni proizvodi životinjskog porekla, što ga čini izborom koji poštuje prirodu i savremene vrednosti održive proizvodnje.

Vinifikacija

Sertifikacija: 100% organsko vino, vegan friendly
Sorta grožđa: 100% Pinot Grigio
Teroar: Subotički rejon/ Palićko vinogorje/ Srbija/ Evropa
Vreme berbe: septembar
Period fermentacije: 15 dana
Količina alkohola: 14,5%
Pakovanje: 0,75 l
Rok upotrebe: neograničeno
Godina berbe: 2024.

Starenje i odležavanje: Vino 10 meseci odležava u inoks tanku, zatim sazreva u strogo kontrolisanim uslovima još 12 meseci u boci.

GASTRONOMSKE PREPORUKE / UPARIVANJE SA HRANOM

Pinot Grigio Organica idealan je pratilac laganih jela od ribe i morskih plodova, belog mesa, svežih salata ili jednostavno – trenutaka uživanja u dobrom društvu.

Otkrijte PETRA Pinot Grigio organica nefiltrirano – vino koje unosi dah svežine i elegancije u svaku priliku, donoseći savršeni balans između jednostavnosti i prefinjenosti.

name: Pinot Noir BARRIQUE – organica unfiltered
short_description: Sophisticated, gentle and at the same time strong, Petra Pinot Noir organica presents the perfect balance between tradition and modern approach to wine-making. The new, unfiltered edition expresses a genuine philosophy of the winery: let the wine speak for itself, without any unnecessary indications.
description:
PETRA Pinot Noir Barrique Organica captures with its ruby-red colour with gentle transparent tones of terracotta characteristic for the variety. Aroma denotes tones of ripen red and forest fruits, accompanied by subtle tones of spices caused by careful maturation.

At the palate, Pinot Noir is silky and balanced with fine tannins and elegant structure. Every drop reveals the depth, layers and warmth which remain long after the tasting. Given the fact that the wine is unfiltered, all of the natural aromas and texture are preserved, providing it full character and genuine expressiveness.

The wine is completely suitable for vegans, since the production didn’t involve any animal products, additionally confirming the Petra winery’s devotion to natural and sustainable approach.

The PETRA Pinot Noir Barrique Organica comes from the shores of the family vineyard lake, cultivated according to international organic production standards.

Vinification

Certification: Organic wine
Grape variety: 100% Pinot Noir
Terroir: Subotica region / Palić vineyards / Serbia / Europe
Harvest time: September
Fermentation: 15 days
Alcohol content: 14,5%
Volume: 0,75 l
Shelf life: unlimited
Vintage: 2024.

Aging and maturation: It is stored for 10 months in 500l oak barrels, medium charred on the inside so that the wine absorbs additional wood aromas during aging. Then it is bottled to age 6 months to finally get the desired Pinot Noir variety wine.

Gastronomic recommendations / Food & Wine pairing

PETRA Pinot Noir is an ideal choice along red and duck meat, mushrooms or mature cheese, but also as a wine suitable for relaxed moments for the ones who would like to feel the essence of elegance in a glass.

name: Pinot Grigio – organica unfiltered
short_description: In the world of wines not many varieties bring as much freshness, lightness and elegance as Pinot Grigio does. Petra winery proudly presents their new edition of this noble variety – the wine that brings together the purity of expression, natural aroma and modern interpretation of traditional wine-making approach.
description:
Petra Pinot Grigio Organica delights with its light yellow colour with green and gray reflection, while denoting characteristic tones of citrus, green apple, white flowers and fresh pears in its aroma. It is exceptionally drinkable at the palate, refreshing and harmonious with gentle minerality and balanced acidity, allowing briskness and taste length.

Since Pinot Grigio is not filtered, it allows it to persevere its authenticity, fullness and natural texture. This approach enables to feel in every glass the spirit of vineyards, the land where the grapes were grown and devotion with which the wine was created.

Another important characteristic of this wine is its vegan adequateness – in the production process no animal products were used, making it a choice which respects nature and contemporary values of sustainable production.

Vinification

Certification: Organic wine, vegan friendly
Grape variety: 100% Pinot Grigio
Terroir: Subotica region/ Palić vineyards/ Serbia/ Europe
Harvest time: September
Fermentation: 15 days
Alcohol content: 14,5%
Packaging: 0,75 l
Shelf life: unlimited
Vintage year: 2024.

Aging and maturation: Stored for 10 months in a stainless steel tank, then matures in strictly controlled conditions for another 12 months.

Gastronomic recommendations / Food & Wine pairing

PETRA Pinot Grigio ideally agrees with light fish and seafood dishes, white meat, fresh salads or simply – moments of pleasure in a fine
company.

name: Traminer – organica unfiltered
short_description: We present you a new type of wine in Petra winery’s portfolio – Traminer, a variety known after its elegance, strong aroma and intense character. This wine arose from the desire to present authentic beauty of the variety through minimal intervention in the cellar, respecting the natural flow of wine.
description:
Petra Traminer Organica captures with its golden-yellow colour and mild cloudiness, as a result of excluding wine filtering. That model of approach conserves the fullness of the taste and aroma complexity, enabling each glass to tell a story of a land, variety and winemakers’ effort.

The wine reveals luxurious tones of rose petals, ripen apricots, honey and light spicy tones on its aroma, together intertwining in harmony. It is full on the palate, rounded and harmonious, with long and elegant finish leaving a sense of warmth and refinement.

This wine holds its particularity in its vegan nature – in the production process no animal products were used, which makes it an ideal choice for everyone seeking clean, and genuine wine, produced with respect towards nature.

Vinification

Certification: Organic wine, vegan friendly
Grape variety: 100% Traminer
Terroir: Subotica region/ Palić vineyards/ Serbia/ Europe
Harvest time: September
Fermentation: 15 days
Alcohol content: 13%
Packaging: 0,75 l
Shelf life: unlimited
Vintage year: 2024.

Aging and maturation: Stored for 10 months in a stainless steel tank, then maturing bottled for another 12 months.

Gastronomic recommendations / Food & Wine pairing

PETRA Traminer perfectly agrees with aromatic dishes, light cheese, dishes with creamy sauces, though it may be a perfect choice for a personal pleasure with a good book or conversation.

name: Cuvée – organica
short_description: PETRA Cuvée Organica je raskošna kupaža dve čuvene sorte grožđa: Merlot i Cabernet Franc, koje smo u saradnji sa prirodom odnegovali i odlično adaptirali u naše vinogorje uz neposrednu obalu jezera Palić.
description:
PETRA Cuvée* Organica je vino tamne rubin boje, sa otmenim ljubičastim nijansama na obodima, umerene pokretljivosti u čaši i sjajne refleksije.

U mirisu dominiraju note crvenog i crnog bobičastog zrelog voća – crvene ribizle, borovnice, kupine, u tragovima čak i višnje. Prožimaju se začinske note crvenog i crnog bibera, te nežni tonovi prefinjenog francuskog hrasta, dajući mu otmenu kompleksnost.

U ukusu su dominantniji začinski tonovi, tanini su meki, a kiseline i alkoholi dobro izbalansirani, pružajući uživaocu potpuni ugođaj.

Sinonim je za vino brižljivo odnegovanih najboljih godina berbi i odležavanja .

Vinifikacija

Sorta grožđa: 60% Merlot i 40% Cabernet Franc
Oblast: Subotički rejon/ Palićko vinogorje/ Srbija/ Evropa
Vreme berbe: oktobar
Period fermentacije: 10 dana
Količina alkohola: 13,5%
Zapremina: 0,75 l
Rok upotrebe: neograničeno
Godina berbe: 2022.

Starenje i odležavanje: Čuva se i neguje u barik buradima i betonskim tankovima jajastog oblika. Polovina vina odležava u hrastovim buradima, a druga polovina vina odležava u betonskom jajetu u periodu od 6 do 8 meseci. Nakon flaširanja, još najmanje godinu dana odležava u boci i tada dobijamo željenu sortnost vina cuvée.

GASTRONOMSKE PREPORUKE / UPARIVANJE SA HRANOM

PETRA Cuvée Organica servirati na sobnoj temperaturi kako bi njegov ukus, aroma i tekstura došli najbolje do izražaja.
Svoj pun potencijal daće uz: biftek u sosu od šumskog voća, teleća i jagnjeća pečenja, grilovana povrća, jake sosove i zrele sireve.

name: Cuvée – organica
short_description: PETRA Cuvée Organica is a sumptuous blend of two famous grape varieties: Merlot and Cabernet Franc, which we grew in cooperation with nature and perfectly adapted to our vineyards along the immediate shore of Lake Palić.
description:
PETRA Cuvée Organica is a wine of dark ruby color, with elegant purple hues on the rims, moderate swirl, and brilliant reflection.
Its aroma is dominated by notes of ripe red and black berry fruit – red currants, blueberries, blackberries, and even traces of sour cherries. It is permeated by spicy notes of red and black pepper and gentle tones of refined French oak, giving it an elegant complexity.
The taste is dominated by spicy tones, the tannins are soft, and the acids and alcohols are well balanced, giving the consumer complete enjoyment.
It is synonymous with wine of carefully grown best vintage and aging grapes.

Vinification

Grape variety: 60% Merlot and 40% Cabernet Franc
Terroir: Subotica region / Palić vineyards / Serbia / Europe
Harvest time: Oktober
Fermentation: 10 days
Alcohol content: 13,5%
Volume: 0,75 l
Shelf life: unlimited
Vintage: 2022.

Aging and maturation: Petra Cuvée Organica is kept and nurtured in barrique barrels and egg-shaped concrete tanks. half of the wine is aged in oak barrels, and the rest of the wine ages in a concrete egg for a period of 6 to 8 months. After bottling, it ages in the bottle for at least another year, and then we get the desired variety of cuvée wine.

Gastronomic recommendations / Food& Wine pairing

PETRA Cuvée Organica should be served at room temperature so that its taste, aroma and texture reach the perfect balance.
It will go perfectly well with: steak in forest fruit sauce, roast veal and lamb, grilled vegetables, strong sauces and mature cheeses.

name: Chocolate pearls & Pinot Noir Barrique
short_description: The combination of wine and handmade luxury chocolates provides a unique experience to the consumer. This is why the masters of their craft, the pastry chefs, had the task of impressing you with their selection. Chocolate pearls are made under special conditions, based on the provided wine sample they are intended to accompany. The base of our chocolate pearls is crafted from rosemary and raspberries, enhanced with high-quality Java milk chocolate and cocoa-rich cream from specially selected Venezuelan high-quality chocolate. The production is entirely manual throughout the entire process, and the chocolate pearls do not contain added sugar, preservatives, or any other additives harmful to health. Storage of this product does not require refrigeration, but it is best kept at 20°C. Those who have experienced it can partially share their impressions with you. It’s up to you to experience them for yourself.

name: Traminer
short_description: “…Our winery produces wines that primarily aim to highlight the varietal characteristics of the grapes, and that is precisely the case with TRAMINER!” The Gubičak Family
description:
PETRA Traminer is a dry white wine made from the homonymous grape variety, excellently adapted to our region on a carefully chosen vineyard plot near Lake Palić.

The wine boasts a light yellow color with a greenish sheen. It has excellent clarity and sparkling reflections.

Its aroma is very appealing, delicate with pronounced fruity notes where hints of apple, melon are present, with a subtle touch of tropical tones in the background that skillfully hide and make this wine particularly complex.

The taste is touchingly fresh, with a presence of minerality where delicate floral characters blend with fruity tones, making it very harmonious and persistent. The finish is fresh, pleasantly sweet with a hint of bitterness, full of floral fruity notes, slightly bitter, and velvety.

Vinification

Grape variety: 100% Traminer
Terroir: Subotica region / Palić vineyards / Serbia / Europe
Harvest time: September
Fermentation: 15 days
Alcohol content: 14,5%
Volume: 0,75 l
Shelf life: unlimited
Vintage: 2020.

Aging and maturation: It is aged for 10 months in stainless steel tanks, then matures for an additional 12 months in the bottle.

Gastronomic recommendations / Food & Wine pairing

Serve PETRA Traminer wine at a temperature of 8°C to 10°C. It reaches its peak when paired with seafood dishes, pasta, grilled or boiled fish, various pies, and can also be a good companion to fruits and desserts.

name: Pinot Noir RESERVA
description:
PETRA Pinot Noir Reserve is produced only in special years when the grapes in the vineyard are the best for great wines.

PETRA Pinot Noir Reserve has a darker ruby red color, but when swirled, the color of the wine changes to brick (terracota), characteristic of red Burgundy wine.

It has excellent clarity and reflections, which are characteristic of older wines.

The Reserve wine aroma is fruity, with hints of vanilla and smoke coming from oak barrels.

Close your eyes and breathe in – you will smell the ripe red fruit and mineral aromas originating from the terroir.

When you take a sip, you will feel elegance, softness, and sweetness at the same time!

The aftertaste is rather pleasant, long-lasting, drinkable, and gentle, with the full freshness of its fruitiness.

Vinification

Grape variety: 100% Pinot Noir
Terroir: Subotica region / Palić vineyards / Serbia / Europe
Harvest time: September
Fermentation: 10 days
Alcohol content: 14,5%
Volume: 0,75 l or upon request – magnum bottle
Shelf life: unlimited
Vintage: best harvest years of Pinot Noir

Aging and maturation: Pinot Noir Reserve ages for 24 months, and often more, in oak barrels of 500l
medium toasted inside, to absorb all the flavors. Then it matures and ages for a minimum of 12 months bottled.

Gastronomic recommendations / Food & Wine pairing

Serve PETRA Pinot Noir Reserve at room temperature so that the taste, aroma and texture can be experienced to the fullest. It will go perfectly well with nice roasts like pork, lamb,and moderate and elegant dishes such as pasta, and it can complement even fish.

name: Pinot Noir BARRIQUE
short_description: PETRA Pinot Noir Barrique is a dry ruby-red red wine with light purple tones on the rim, that, when swirled, turns into brick (terracotta), characteristic of red Burgundy wine.
description:
It has excellent clarity and reflection with great swirl.

This wine has a very pleasant aroma rich in fruitiness.

It captivates with its aroma rich in notes of ripe cherry and raspberry; it is mineral, with fine subtle notes of oak wood and slight hints of licorice.

The taste is permeated with elegance and inherent sweetness. Its softness and subtlety are reflected on the palate.

The aftertaste is very pleasant, long-lasting, drinkable, and gentle, with the full freshness of its fruitiness.

Vinification

Grape variety: 100% Pinot Noir
Terroir: Subotica region / Palić vineyards / Serbia / Europe
Harvest time: September
Fermentation: 10 days
Alcohol content: 14,5%
Volume: 0,75 l
Shelf life: unlimited
Vintage: 2016.

Aging and maturation: It is stored for 6 to 8 months in 500l oak barrels, medium charred on the inside so that the wine absorbs additional wood aromas during aging. Then it is bottled to age for at least another year to finally get the desired Pinot Noir variety wine.

Gastronomic recommendations / Food & Wine pairing

Serve PETRA Pinot Noir at room temperature so that its taste, aroma, and texture are fully enjoyed. It will reach its full potential when served with nice roasts such as pork, lamb, and moderate and elegant dishes such as pasta, and can even complement fish.

name: Dessert Traminer
short_description: PETRA Dessert Traminer is a sweet dessert wine.
description:
Late-harvest wine produced by a special approach to both grape production and wine production tehnology.

We get golden yellow wine with very pronounced aromas of flowers (rose, geranium) and dried fruit, by carefully harvesting grapes at full ripeness, with partially developed botrytis,
and then naturally drying them in crates.

Its taste is full-bodied, harmonious, sweetish and persistent, captivating with its loveliness.
Delicate honey and fruity notes make the aroma of this wine nectar-like sensual and rich.

Vinification

Grape variety: 100% Traminer
Terroir: Subotica region / Palić vineyards / Serbia / Europe
Harvest time: November
Fermentation: 15 days
Alcohol content: 13,0%
Volume: 0,5 l
Shelf life: unlimited
Vintage: 2017.

Aging and maturation: Half of the wine ages for 8 months in “concret egg”, the rest of the wine ages for 8 months in a stainless steel tank, then matures for another 12 months in the bottle or often longer.

name: Rose&Co
description:
PETRA Rose&Co is a refreshing sparkling wine made from three grape varieties: Pinot Noir, Traminer, and Pinot Grigio.

With a delicate salmon color and a subtle sheen, this wine captivates with the aroma of floral and fruity notes.

It is accompanied by a well-balanced taste, showcasing fullness and gentle yet refreshing acidity, leading to a pleasant and long-lasting finish.

Vinification

Grape variety: Pinot Noir, Traminer, Pinot Grigio
Terroir: Subotica region / Palić vineyards / Serbia / Europe
Harvest time: September
Fermentation: 15 days
Alcohol content: 13,0%
Volume: 0,75 l
Shelf life: unlimited
Vintage: 2020.

Aging and maturation: Stored for 10 months in stainless steel tanks in order to preserve freshness and varietal characteristics, then maturing bottled for another 12 months.

Gastronomic recommendations / Food & Wine pairing

PETRA Rose&Co should be served chilled at 6 – 8°C to allow the mild effervescence of this interesting wine to provide a full experience and enjoyment to the taster.

It is recommended as an aperitif and pairs excellently with salty snacks, lean fish-based appetizers, chicken salad, cold meats in aspic, mushroom risotto, fruit tarts, and dried fruits.

name: Rose
description:
PETRA Rose is a wine made from grape varieties: Pinot Noir, Traminer, and Pinot Grigio.

It has a delicate salmon color with a subtle sheen.

The aroma is rich with fruity notes of red berries, strawberries, raspberries, and pomegranate.

The taste is fruity, rounded with beautiful acidity.

Mineral tones are present, harmonizing with playful hints of wildflowers, providing a refreshing sensation.

The finish is intense, persistent, characterized by fruity traits, good structure, and pleasant sweet bitterness.

Vinification

Grape variety: Pinot Noir, Traminer, Pinot Grigio
Terroir: Subotica region / Palić vineyards / Serbia / Europe

name: Pinot Noir BARRIQUE – organica
short_description: “…Organic wines require much more attention and effort, both in the vineyard and the cellar, and in the winery as a whole. The work results in high wine quality standards and inevitably leads to higher prices for organic wines compared to their non-organic “relatives” from the same family… Our winery produces wines primarily intended to emphasize the varietal characteristics of the grapes.” The Gubičak Family
description:
PETRA Pinot Noir Barrique Organica is an organic dry ruby-red red wine with light purple tones on the rim, that, when swirled, turns into brick (terracotta), characteristic of red Burgundy wine.

It has excellent clarity and reflection with great swirl.

This wine has a very pleasant aroma rich in fruitiness.

It captivates with its aroma rich in notes of ripe cherry and raspberry; it is mineral, with fine subtle notes of oak wood and slight hints of licorice.

The taste is permeated with elegance and inherent sweetness. Its softness and subtlety are reflected on the palate.

The aftertaste is very pleasant, long-lasting, drinkable, and gentle, with the full freshness of its fruitiness.

The PETRA Pinot Noir Barrique Organica comes from the shores of the family vineyard lake, cultivated according to international organic production standards.

Vinification

Certification: Organic wine
Grape variety: 100% Pinot Noir
Terroir: Subotica region / Palić vineyards / Serbia / Europe
Harvest time: September
Fermentation: 10 days
Alcohol content: 13,0%
Volume: 0,75 l
Shelf life: unlimited
Vintage: 2021.

Aging and maturation: It is stored for 6 to 8 months in 500l oak barrels, medium charred on the inside so that the wine absorbs additional wood aromas during aging. Then it is bottled to age for at least another year to finally get the desired Pinot Noir variety wine.

Gastronomic recommendations / Food & Wine pairing

Serve PETRA Pinot Noir at room temperature so that its taste, aroma, and texture are fully enjoyed. It will reach its full potential when served with nice roasts such as pork, lamb, and moderate and elegant dishes such as pasta, and can even complement fish.

Osnova naših čokoladnih perlica napravljena je od ruzmarina i malina, a nadograđena je Java mlečnom čokoladom vrhunskog kvaliteta i kremom s visokim sadržajem kakaoa iz posebno selektirane Venecuela visokokvalitetne čokolade. name: Pinot Noir RESERVA
description:
PETRA Pinot Noir Reserva se proizvodi samo u posebnim godinama, kada je grožđe u vinogradu najbolje za velika vina.

PETRA Pinot Noir Reserva je tamnije rubin crvene boje, ali kada se zavrti, vino u čaši prelazi u cigla boju (terracota) koja je karakteristična za crni Burgundac.

Odlične je bistrine i refleksije karakteristične za starija vina.

Miris ovog vina je voćni sa primesama vanile i dima, koji dolaze od hrastovih buradi.

Zatvorite oči i udahnite – osetićete zrelo crveno voće i mineralne mirise koji potiču od teroara.

Kada uzmete gutljaj, osetićete istovremeno – eleganciju, mekoću i slast!

Završnica je veoma prijatna, dugotrajna, pitka i nežna sa punom svežinom svoje voćnosti.

Vinifikacija

Sorta grožđa: 100% Pinot Noir
Oblast: Subotički rejon/ Palićko vinogorje/ Srbija/ Evropa
Vreme berbe: septembar

Količina alkohola: 14,5%

Godina berbe: najbolje godine berbi Pinot Noir-a

PETRA Pinot Noir Reserva servirati na sobnoj temperaturi kako bi njegov buke najbolje došao do izražaja. Svoj pun potencijal daće poslužen uz lepa pečenja poput prasećeg, jagnjećeg, te umerena i elegantna jela kao što su paste, a može upotpuniti čak i ribu.

Probranom berbom grožđa u punoj zrelosti, sa delimično razvijenim botritisom, a nakon toga i prirodnim sušenjem u gajbicama, dobijeno je vino zlatnožute boje sa vrlo izraženim mirisima cveća (ruže, muškatle) i suvog voća.

Ukus mu je pun, harmoničan, slatkast i postojan, pleni svojom ljupkošću. Nežne medene i voćne note čine aromu ovog vina senzualnom i bogatom poput nektara.

Sorta grožđa: 100% Traminac
Teroar: Subotički rejon/ Palićko vinogorje/ Srbija/ Evropa
Vreme berbe: novembar
Period fermentacije: 15 dana
Količina alkohola: 13,0%
Pakovanje: 0,5 l
Rok upotrebe: neograničeno
Godina berbe: 2017.

Starenje i odležavanje: Polovina vina odležava 8 meseci u betonskom jajetu, dok druga polovina vina odležava 8 meseci u inoks tanku, potom sazreva još 12 meseci u boci, a često i duže.

PETRA Desertni Traminac se preporučuje uz manje slatke deserte, voćni kolač (pita od jabuka), voćne i čokoladne torte, krem poslastice, a posebno se ističe u kontrastno postavljenom odabiru hrane koja ima gorku nit, poput foa-gra (guščije jetre), kao i pikantnih zrelih sireva.

name: Dessert Traminer – organica
short_description: “Organic wines require much more attention and effort, both in the vineyard and the cellar, and in the winery as a whole. The work results in high wine quality standards and inevitably leads to higher prices for organic wines compared to their non-organic “relatives” from the same family… Our winery produces wines primarily intended to emphasize the varietal characteristics of the grapes, and TRAMINER wine hits the spot!” The Gubičak Family
description:
Dessert Traminer Organica is an organic sweet dessert wine, rich in beautiful aromas and scents. Late-harvest wine produced by a special approach to both grape production and wine production
tehnology. We get golden yellow wine with very pronounced aromas of flowers (rose, geranium) and dried fruit, by carefully harvesting grapes at full ripeness, with partially developed botrytis,
and then naturally drying them in crates.

Its taste is full-bodied, harmonious, sweetish and persistent, captivating with its loveliness. Delicate honey and fruity notes make the aroma of this wine nectar-like sensual and rich.

Dessert Traminer Organica is a wine produced according to the international organic certification
standards.

Vinification

Certification: Organic wine
Grape variety: 100% Traminer
Terroir: Subotica region/  Palić vineyards/ Serbia/ Europe
Harvest time: November
Fermentation: 15 days
Alcohol content: 14,0%
Volume: 0,35 l
Shelf life: unlimited
Vintage: 2021.

Aging and maturation: Half of the wine ages for 8 months in “concrete egg”, the rest of the wine ages for 8 months in a stainless steel tank, then matures for another 12 months in the bottle or often longer.

Gastronomic recommendations / Food & Wine pairing

Dessert Traminer Organica is recommended with less sweet desserts, fruit cake (apple pie), fruit and chocolate tarts, creamy treats. It especially pairs well with food that has a bitter touch, as a nice contrasting note, such as “foi gras” (goose liver), as well as spicy moldy cheese.

description:
Petra Traminer Organica is an organic dry white wine produced from the Traminer variety, fully adapted to our climate and grown on a carefully selected plot by the shore of Palić Lake.

Traminer Organica is produced according to the international organic certification standards.

The wine is characterized by a light yellow color with a greenish sheen on its rim. This wine has excellent clarity and sparkling reflection.

Its smell is captivating, gentle with pronounced fruity aromas with notes of apple and melon and a slight touch of somehow skillfully hidden background tropical tones that make this wine particularly complex.

Its taste is touchingly fresh, with preserved minerality in which delicate floral characters blend with fruity tones, making it rather harmonious and persistent. Its aftertaste is fresh, of pleasantly sweet bitterness, rich in floral fruit notes, slightly pungent and velvety.

Vinification

Grape variety: 100% Traminer
Terroir: Subotica region/ Palić vineyards/ Serbia/ Europe

O vinu

PETRA Traminac Organica je organsko suvo belo vino dobijeno od istoimene sorte grožđa, potpuno adaptirane na naše podneblje i odnegovane na pažljivo biranoj parceli uz samu obalu jezera Palić.

Ukus mu je dirljivo svež, s prisutnom mineralnošću u kojoj se nežni cvetni karakteri stapaju sa voćnim tonovima, te ga čine veoma harmoničnim i postojanim. Završnica mu je sveža, prijatno slatke gorčine, prepune cvetnih voćnih nota, lagano opora i baršunasta.

Sorta grožđa: 100% Traminac
Teroar: Subotički rejon/ Palićko vinogorje/ Srbija/ Evropa
Vreme berbe: septembar

Pakovanje: 0,75 l

short_description: The exclusivity of the taste and aroma of wine hand made in cooperation with nature!
description:
PETRA Orange Organica is something new in Petra Winery’s offer!

Orange wine is obtained from white Pinot Grigio variety using the red wine method.

The wine’s copper color, crystal clearness and stellar reflection are what will immediately delight the consumer.

Fullness of nougat tones and the gentle drift of field flower scent are complemented by mild barrique notes.

It is full-bodied, very delicious with mild spiciness and a long-lasting aftertaste.

PETRA Orange Organica – the exclusivity of the taste and aroma of wine hand made in cooperation with nature!

Vinification

Certification: Organic wine
Grape variety: 100% Pinot Grigio
Terroir: Subotica region/  Palić vineyards/ Serbia/ Europe
Harvest time: September
Fermentation: 15 days
Alcohol content: 13,5%
Volume: 0,75 l
Shelf life: unlimited
Vintagee: 2021.

Aging and maturation: Half of the wine is aged for 8 months in a “concrete egg”, the rest is aged for 8 months in barriques barrels, and after that they are combined into one (coupage) – with a luxurious taste and smell.
The wine ages in the bottle and matures in controlled conditions. The aging period is adjustable, it depends on the year of harvest, varying between 12 and 18 months.

PETRA Orange should be served at a temperature of 10°C to 12°C, in order to experience all the potential of this very complex wine. It would be best to pair it with seafood pasta and fish, then with duck or turkey, and it would also complement dishes prepared under the stove. We recommend with foods from local producers of healthy food.
